article_context: 借 Facebook 收购 WhatsApp 与 Amazon 收购 Whole Foods，讨论数字平台通过用户关系与行为数据积累权力，并指出传统竞争法难以处理“用户并非付费客户”的新型市场关系。

article.title: 阅读 Text 3 · 数字巨头真正经营的商品，是我们的数据
article.background: 借 Facebook 收购 WhatsApp 与 Amazon 收购 Whole Foods，讨论数字平台通过用户关系与行为数据积累权力，并指出传统竞争法难以处理“用户并非付费客户”的新型市场关系。

sentences.en: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing - Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for $13.5bn, but two years ago Facebook paid even more than that to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service, which doesn't have any physical product at all.
sentences.zh: 数字经济巨头的力量和野心令人惊叹——亚马逊刚刚宣布以135亿美元收购高端连锁杂货店 Whole Foods，而两年前，Facebook 为收购根本没有实体产品的即时通讯服务 WhatsApp，花的钱甚至更多。

segments.text: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing - Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for $13.5bn, but two years ago Facebook paid even more than that to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service, which doesn't have any physical product at all.

sentences.en: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.
sentences.zh: WhatsApp 能提供给 Facebook 的，是一张复杂而精细的网络，记录着用户的朋友关系和社交生活。

segments.text: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.

sentences.en: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
sentences.zh: Facebook 当时向欧盟委员会承诺，不会把电话号码与 Facebook 身份信息关联起来，但交易一完成，它几乎立刻就违背了这一承诺。

segments.text: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.

sentences.en: Even without knowing what was in the messages, the knowledge of who sent them and to whom was enormously revealing and still could be.
sentences.zh: 即使不知道消息的具体内容，仅仅知道是谁发给了谁，也能揭示大量信息，而且这种信息至今仍可能极具价值。

segments.text: Even without knowing what was in the messages, the knowledge of who sent them and to whom was enormously revealing and still could be.

sentences.en: What political journalist, what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May's enemies are currently plotting?
sentences.zh: 哪个政治记者、哪个党鞭会不想知道，那些正被特雷莎·梅的反对者用来谋划行动的 WhatsApp 群里究竟都有谁？

segments.text: What political journalist, what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May's enemies are currently plotting?

sentences.en: It may be that the value of Whole Foods to Amazon is not so much the 460 shops it owns, but the records of which customers have purchased what.
sentences.zh: Whole Foods 对亚马逊的价值，也许并不主要在它拥有的460家门店，而在于记录了哪些顾客买过什么的消费数据。

segments.text: It may be that the value of Whole Foods to Amazon is not so much the 460 shops it owns, but the records of which customers have purchased what.

sentences.en: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power.
sentences.zh: 竞争法似乎是解决这种权力失衡的唯一办法。

segments.text: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power.

sentences.en: For one thing, it is very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy.
sentences.zh: 首先，与数字经济内部的变化速度相比，竞争法的反应实在太慢。

segments.text: For one thing, it is very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy.

sentences.en: By the time a problem has been addressed and remedied it may have vanished in the marketplace, to be replaced by new abuses of power.
sentences.zh: 等一个问题终于得到处理和补救时，它可能早已从市场上消失，取而代之的是新的权力滥用。

segments.text: By the time a problem has been addressed and remedied it may have vanished in the marketplace, to be replaced by new abuses of power.

sentences.en: But there is a deeper conceptual problem, too.
sentences.zh: 而且，这里还有一个更深层的概念问题。

segments.text: But there is a deeper conceptual problem, too.

sentences.en: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.
sentences.zh: 按照当前的解释，竞争法处理的是消费者在经济上受到的不利影响；可当这些服务的用户根本不付费时，这种损害就并不明显。

segments.text: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.

sentences.en: The users of their services are not their customers.
sentences.zh: 这些服务的用户，并不是这些公司的客户。

segments.text: The users of their services are not their customers.

sentences.en: That would be the people who buy advertising from them - and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
sentences.zh: 真正的客户是向它们购买广告的人——而 Facebook 和 Google 这两家虚拟世界的巨头主导着数字广告市场，使其他所有媒体和娱乐公司处于不利地位。

segments.text: That would be the people who buy advertising from them - and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.

sentences.en: The product they're selling is data, and we, the users, convert our lives to data for the benefit of the digital giants.
sentences.zh: 它们出售的产品是数据，而我们这些用户，则把自己的生活转化为数据，让数字巨头从中获益。

segments.text: The product they're selling is data, and we, the users, convert our lives to data for the benefit of the digital giants.

sentences.en: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
sentences.zh: 就像有些蚂蚁“饲养”蚜虫，以获取蚜虫进食时分泌的蜜露一样，Google 也在“饲养”我们，以获取我们的数字生活所产生的数据。

segments.text: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.

sentences.en: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.
sentences.zh: 蚂蚁会把捕食性昆虫赶离蚜虫取食的地方；Gmail 则把垃圾邮件发送者挡在我们的收件箱之外。

segments.text: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.

sentences.en: It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
sentences.zh: 即使双方都从中受益，这种关系仍让人感觉既不人性，也谈不上民主。

segments.text: It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
